Definition: to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tie, bind, bind on, bind up, saddle, restrain, bandage, govern; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bind, bind on; 1a2) to bind up; 1b) (Piel) to bind, restrain; 1c) (Pual) to be bound up
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
